title: Yemen's Houthis confirm launching dozens of missiles and drones at Saudi Arabia
text:
Yemen's Houthis confirm launching dozens of missiles and drones at Saudi Arabia"

"Aramco facilities in Abha, Najran, Jizan, and the Khamis Mushait Air Force Base were targeted, per military spox Yahya Saree"

"'We will continue our operations deep into Saudi territory'
